Name: Vintage Tram Wagon Farmhouse (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This content pack changes the farmhouse to look like a little old tram wagon that becomes a little fancier with each house upgrade.
During the winter, the building is covered in snow. You can choose a desaturated snow version using Generic Mod Config Menu if the saturated snow clashes with a recolor you are using. 
Once fully upgraded, the tram wagon can be fully painted, as shown in the example pictures on this mod page.

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Other than the desaturated snow option, this content pack does not have visual variations as of now, so it may not be compatible with every recolor out there. You are free to make and publish your own texture if you wish, as specified below. Other than that, apart from other mods that change the farmhouse, there shouldn't be any compatibility issues as far as I'm aware.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
